text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
「できるできないの問題じゃない。
やるしかなければ、やるだけだ」
text.official_en: “It’s not a question of can or can’t. There are some things in life you just do.”

text.jp: あきらめて降伏する
text.official_en: Surrender.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとライトニングは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and she are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Lightning are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとライトニングは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and she have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Lightning are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield her power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いつも自分を後回しにして抱え込む。
彼女には、そんな不器用なところがありました。
text.official_en: One such individual is Lightning, who has a tendency to prioritize the needs of others—even when she should prioritize her own.
text.real_en: She tended to put herself last and shoulder every burden alone. It was one of her awkward qualities.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
けれどライトニングたちは、すべてが無になる
結末を覚悟の上で、宿命に抗ったのです。
text.official_en: Lightning and her companions, however, refused to sit idly by; they would do their utmost to defy fate, no matter the cost.
text.real_en: But Lightning and her companions defied fate, prepared even for an ending where everything would be reduced to nothing.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
しかし彼女たちの日常は、コクーンの社会を
脅かす存在との遭遇によって崩壊します。
text.official_en: Though Lightning strove to provide her sister with a normal life, it was not to be; their world was shattered by a threat to all of Cocoon.
text.real_en: But an encounter with a threat to Cocoon’s society shattered their everyday lives.

text.jp: それでも故郷に帰還する
text.official_en: Return home all the same.

text.jp: それは、神々が人を呪縛する異界の記憶――
text.official_en: In this world, humans’ fates are bound by shackles wrought by the divine.
text.real_en: A memory of another world where the gods bind humanity in chains...

text.jp:
ただ奇跡を願うのではなく、祈るのでもなく
誓う意志が、闇をつらぬく閃光となります。
text.official_en: You neither wish nor pray for a miracle—such would be pure folly—but instead vow to do all you can to realize the impossible.
text.real_en: Rather than merely wishing or praying for a miracle, the will to make it happen becomes a flash of light piercing the darkness.

text.jp: ただ滅びの時を待つ
text.official_en: Patiently await the world’s ruin.
text.real_en: Wait for the world to end.

text.jp:
どこまで旅しても解決策が見つからないまま、
故郷の存亡をかけた選択をつきつけられます。
text.official_en: Regrettably, they found no such method; instead, they were presented with only one choice—one which may doom their homeland.
text.real_en: No matter how far they traveled, they found no answer. They were forced to choose the fate of their homeland.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
もしもライトニングが孤独だったなら
逃亡に疲れて降伏したかもしれません。
text.official_en: Had no one been by Lightning’s side, she may have grown weary of running and eventually chosen to surrender.

text.jp:
クリスタルの半神たちが人間を庇護する
安全で快適な社会、コクーン。
text.official_en: Above its lands floated Cocoon—an orb within which demigods provided humanity with safety and comfort.
text.real_en: Cocoon was a safe, comfortable society where demigods of the Crystals protected humanity.

text.jp:
ライトニングの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: Her thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en: Lightning’s feelings will become a Vision, and surely a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
ライトニングは、子供らしい素直な心を抑え、
急いで大人になろうとしました。
text.official_en: Lightning, too, sought to suppress her inner child; by doing so, she hoped it would expedite her journey to adulthood.
text.real_en: Lightning tried to grow up too quickly, suppressing the honest feelings of a child.

text.jp:
ライトニングもはじめは怒りと絶望にかられ
捨て身で戦おうとしました。
text.official_en: At first, Lightning, too, gave in to rage and despair, and threw herself headlong into the fray.

text.jp:
世界中が敵となった絶体絶命の状況でも
人を支える想いがあります。
text.official_en: Even when your back is to the wall and the entire world is against you, there is still something to which you can cling.
text.real_en: Even when the whole world turns against you, there are feelings that can sustain you.

text.jp:
人々は平穏な暮らしを楽しんでいましたが
彼女は大きな責任を負っていました。
text.official_en: While most people there led peaceful, quiet lives, one woman’s was not, as she shouldered a heavy burden.
text.real_en: Most people enjoyed peaceful lives, but one woman bore a heavy responsibility.

text.jp:
勝算が見えなくても、戦うしかない状況……
ライトニングなら、こう言うでしょう。
text.official_en: To continue the fight against all odds... This philosophy calls to mind a quote by Lightning herself.

text.jp:
困ったときに助けを求めるのは当然ですが
それが苦手な人もいます。
text.official_en: To ask for help in a time of need may be simple for some, but for others, it can be quite difficult.

text.jp:
奇跡を期待するなど愚かだとしても
行動しなければ奇跡は起こりません。
text.official_en: The odds of a miracle occurring may be strikingly low, yet they would be zero should you take no action.
text.real_en: Even if hoping for a miracle seems foolish, it cannot happen unless you act.

text.jp: 奇跡を起こすと誓う
text.official_en: Vow to succeed, even should it require a miracle.
text.real_en: Vow to make a miracle happen.

text.jp:
家族を守るために、いままでの自分を捨てて
新しい道で成長をめざすのですね。
text.official_en: You feel that, in order to protect those dear to you, you must sometimes walk a new path—and learn new skills that will aid you on it.
text.real_en: To protect your family, you would leave your old self behind and seek to grow along a new path.

text.jp: 希望を支えに生きのびる
text.official_en: Hope for the best.
text.real_en: Survive by holding on to hope.

text.jp:
彼女たちは呪いをかけられ、ルシと呼ばれて
忌み嫌われる存在に変えられてしまったのです。
text.official_en: Ultimately, she and her companions were cursed—branded as l’Cie and fated to endure derision from the rest of humanity.

text.jp:
彼女の名は、ライトニング……。
あなたの想いが、彼女との絆になる。
text.official_en: That woman’s name was Lightning, and it is with her you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: Her name was Lightning... Your feelings will form a bond with her.

text.jp:
彼女は同じ運命を背負った仲間と支えあい、
コクーンを逃れて、救いを求めますが……
text.official_en: Bolstered by companions who shared her predicament, Lightning left Cocoon in search of a method by which to save it.
text.real_en: Supported by companions who shared her fate, she fled Cocoon in search of salvation, but...

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. If you were...

text.jp:
故郷を救いに帰りたい。でも帰還という選択が
世界の終わりを招くかもしれない――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Though she and her companions ardently wished to return to Cocoon, doing so could herald the end of their world. Were you in their position, what would you do?

text.jp:
早く大人になり、強くなって家族を守る……
幼い考え方とはいえ、嘘偽りなく真剣です。
text.official_en: You would assume your parents’ role, regardless of your age. Though not the most feasible idea, it is, without a doubt, a sincere one.
text.real_en: You would grow up quickly and become strong to protect your family... It may be a childish idea, but it is entirely sincere.

text.jp: 早く大人になろうとする
text.official_en: Try to act as a parent.
text.real_en: Try to grow up quickly.

text.jp: 死を覚悟して抵抗する
text.official_en: Fight back, even if it spells your death.

text.jp:
無謀であろうとも、逃げまわるより逆襲したい。
そう思うのも、無理はありません。
text.official_en: Even were it considered to be foolhardy, fighting at least gives the appearance of agency, whereas running does not.
text.real_en: Even if it is reckless, you would rather fight back than keep running. That is understandable.

text.jp:
理不尽な呪いのせいで、人々から憎まれ
追われる身になったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to unexpectedly fall victim to a curse, thereby becoming the object of humanity’s ire, what would you do?

text.jp:
生きるものは死に、かたちあるものは滅ぶ。
静かな最期に救われる魂もあるでしょう。
text.official_en: That which lives shall die, and that which holds shape shall turn to dust—such a sentiment may prove comforting to some.
text.real_en: All living things die, and all things with form eventually perish. Some souls may find peace in a quiet end.

text.jp:
神話に立ち向かう異界の幻影　ライトニング
心なき神に呪われても、宿命に抗う閃光。
text.official_en:
Opponent of the Gods Lightning
The soldier who broke her curse and defied fate.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision defying the gods: Lightning. A flash of light resisting fate, even when cursed by heartless gods.

text.jp:
絶望していた彼女が逃亡のさなかに見つけた
守るべきもの……それは希望でした。
text.official_en: When Lightning teetered on the precipice of despair, what brought her back from the edge was a single sentiment—hope.
text.real_en: Amid her flight, Lightning, who had fallen into despair, found something worth protecting... Hope.

text.jp:
自分のせいで世界が混乱するなら、
剣を捨てるのも、潔い選択です。
text.official_en: Were your very existence to bring untold calamity, none could fault you for laying down your sword.
text.real_en: If your presence is throwing the world into chaos, laying down your sword may be a noble choice.

text.jp: 自分を捨てて努力する
text.official_en: Part ways with your old self.
text.real_en: Give up who you used to be and work hard.

text.jp:
若くして両親を亡くし、妹とふたりで
生きていくことになったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were both of your parents to pass away, leaving you and your younger sister to fend for yourselves from a young age, what would you do?

text.jp: 誰かに助けてもらう
text.official_en: Ask someone for help.

text.jp:
軍に入隊した彼女も、本当の名前を捨てて
「ライトニング」と名乗ります。
text.official_en: Similarly, “Lightning” was not always her name, but she adopted it once she enlisted in the military.
text.real_en: When she joined the military, she discarded her real name and began calling herself Lightning.
